product_overview: A cloud-ready perpetual inventory management backend that provides authentication, admin user management, and baseline APIs for health and future inventory operations. The system supports role-based access (admin vs user) and is designed to accept CSV imports and transactional inventory entries per the project roadmap.
core_goals: Replace manual/mental inventory tracking with a reliable digital system that provides real-time stock visibility.
Provide secure, JWT-based authentication and role-based authorization (admin and standard user).
Enable administrators to manage users safely (create, update, activate/deactivate) without exposing password hashes.
Support eventual CSV bulk imports and transaction workflows (receipts, adjustments, transfers) to accelerate go-live data loading.
Provide simple operational APIs (health check, transaction history, stock position) with auditability (created_by).

features.name: Health Check API
features.description: Lightweight endpoint to verify the API process is running and return a timestamped status for monitoring and automated checks.
user_flows: GET /api/health -> Receive 200 with {status, message, timestamp} (happy path)
GET /api/health when server has a runtime error -> Receive 500 with error message (error path)

features.name: Authentication API
features.description: JWT-based login, session inspection, and logout for users. Returns a token on successful authentication; token must be supplied in Authorization header for protected endpoints.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with body {username, password} (valid credentials) -> Receive 200 with {token, user} (happy path)
GET /api/auth/me with header Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with {user} (token validated)
POST /api/auth/logout with header Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with {message} (acknowledge logout)
POST /api/auth/login with body {username, password} (invalid credentials) -> Receive 401 Invalid credentials (error path)
GET /api/auth/me without Authorization header -> Receive 401 No token or invalid token (error path)
POST /api/auth/login with missing/invalid fields -> Receive 400 with validation error array (error path)

features.name: User Management API (Admin)
features.description: Admin-only CRUD operations for user accounts: list users, create new users, update user fields (fullName, role, password), and activate/deactivate accounts. Password hashes are not returned in responses.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with {token, user} (admin token) -> GET /api/users with header Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with {users: User[]} (happy path - list users)

POST /api/auth/login with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with {token, user} -> POST /api/users with header Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {username, password, fullName, role} -> Receive 201 with created User (happy path - create user)

POST /api/auth/login with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with {token, user} -> PUT /api/users/:id with header Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {fullName, role, password} -> Receive 200 with updated User (happy path - update user)

POST /api/auth/login with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with {token, user} -> PATCH /api/users/:id/status with header Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {isActive: false} -> Receive 200 with updated User (happy path - change status)
POST /api/users with header Authorization: Bearer <non-admin-token> and body {username, password, fullName, role} -> Receive 403 Admin access required (error path - forbidden for non-admin)
POST /api/users with header Authorization: Bearer <admin-token> and body {username already taken, ...} -> Receive 409 Username already taken (error path - duplicate username)
PUT /api/users/:id with header Authorization: Bearer <admin-token> and body {} (no fields) -> Receive 400 Validation error or no fields to update (error path)
PATCH /api/users/:id/status with header Authorization: Bearer <admin-token> attempting to set isActive:false for own user id -> Receive 400 Cannot deactivate own account (error path)
GET /api/users without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized (error path)

features.name: Planned: CSV Import & Core Transaction APIs
features.description: Planned endpoints to support CSV imports for vendors/items, fast receipt entry, stock position calculation, and transaction history for phases 2-3. These endpoints are defined in the product roadmap and should provide preview/validation steps before committing bulk changes.
user_flows: POST /api/vendors/import/preview with header Authorization: Bearer <admin-token> and multipart/form-data file=vendors.csv -> Receive 200 with preview {rows, validationErrors} (happy path - preview)
POST /api/vendors/import with header Authorization: Bearer <admin-token> and body {confirm: true, previewId} -> Receive 201 with {importedCount, errors} (happy path - commit import)
POST /api/items/import/preview with header Authorization: Bearer <admin-token> and multipart/form-data file=items.csv -> Receive 200 with preview {rows, validationErrors} (happy path - preview items)
POST /api/items/import with header Authorization: Bearer <admin-token> and body {confirm: true, previewId} -> Receive 201 with {importedCount, errors} (happy path - commit items)

POST /api/transactions/receipts with header Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {itemId, vendorId, location, quantity, unit_cost, transaction_date, invoice_number} -> Receive 201 with created Transaction and updated stock (happy path - create receipt)
GET /api/stock-position?itemId=<id>&location=<ADEL|CALHOUN> with header Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with {itemId, location, quantityOnHand} (happy path - check stock position)
GET /api/transactions?itemId=<id>&from=<date>&to=<date> with header Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with {transactions: Transaction[]} (happy path - transaction history)
POST /api/items/import/preview with header Authorization: Bearer <admin-token> and malformed CSV -> Receive 400 with validation error array (error path - invalid CSV format)
POST /api/transactions/receipts with header Authorization: Bearer <token> and missing required fields -> Receive 400 Validation error (error path - bad request)
POST /api/transactions/receipts with header Authorization: Bearer <token> referencing unknown itemId -> Receive 404 Item not found (error path)
GET /api/transactions without Authorization header -> Receive 401 No token or invalid token (error path)
